{{DISPLAYTITLE:Devito}}
'''Devito: Symbolic Wave Propagation & Finite-Difference DSL'''
[[Category:Principia Machina]] [[Category:Tools]]

== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
'''Devito''' is a Python-based domain-specific language (DSL) and compiler for solving wave equations and continuum spatial PDEs using high-order finite-difference methods. Built directly on top of SymPy, Devito translates high-level mathematical field expressions into highly optimized, parallelized C/OpenMP/CUDA code.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''Maxwell & Vacuum Wave Dynamics (9.5/10):''' Devito excels at acoustic, elastic, and electromagnetic vector wave equations. It provides automated finite-difference spatial discretization for coupled differential operators (<math>\nabla \times \mathbf{E}</math>, <math>\nabla \cdot \mathbf{B}</math>, <math>\frac{\partial^2 \phi}{\partial t^2} - c^2 \nabla^2 \phi = 0</math>).
* '''SymPy Symbolic Definition Interface:''' Users write continuous PDE field equations using standard SymPy notation; Devito automatically manages stencil generation, boundary conditions, and memory alignment.
* '''High-Performance GPU Compilation:''' Generates hardware-optimized CUDA/OpenACC kernels for large-scale 3D grid vacuum simulations.

== Strategic Role in SVD ==
Devito serves as the primary high-throughput wave propagation engine for simulating 3D electromagnetic displacement currents and vacuum field dynamics within the Principia Machina research registry.
